4 اخظاهُ : see what immediately precedes. [Freytag also mentions اخظى, on the authority of the “ Deewán el-Hudhaleeyeen, ” as signifying He, or it, caused the flesh in the arm to become prominent, so that the muscles appeared.] And اخظى also signifies He, or it, fattened, or rendered fat, (K and TA in art. خظى,) the body. (TA.) ＝
-A2- اخظى [as an intrans. v.] (said of a man, IAar) He became fat. (IAar, K in art. خظى.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
